informationTypes.name: Photos
informationTypes.description: Freely licensed photos of the artist from Wikimedia Commons, with photographer and licence

assistant.instructions: Freely licensed images from Wikimedia Commons, every one with its author, licence and file page. search_images is read-only. Prefer `artist` (the artist's own Commons category, found through Wikidata — exact name match, so it does not return a different artist) over free-text `query`, which matches anything with the words in its title (a band named after a town returns the town). Use `category` to drill into a subcategory listed in an earlier answer. Captions come from uploaders and can be wrong or in another language — check them against what you know before repeating them, and set thumbnails=true to get small previews when you need to look. For a cue sheet, get_cue_context already includes this plugin's artist gallery in `images`; search only when you need more. Credit the author when you use an image.

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Find freely licensed images on Wikimedia Commons. Give exactly one of: artist (that artist's Commons category via Wikidata — best), category (a Commons category name), or query (free-text search of file titles and descriptions — noisy). Returns images with url (display size, ≤1280px wide), optional thumbUrl, original width/height, description, date, author, license, licenseUrl, credit (a ready-made attribution line) and pageUrl, plus the category's subcategories when listing one. Read-only.

artist.description: Artist or band name — resolved to their Commons category through Wikidata

category.description: A Commons category, with or without the 'Category:' prefix (e.g. 'Portishead (band)')

query.description: Free-text search over Commons file pages

minWidth.description: Skip images narrower than this many pixels (default 800)

thumbnails.description: Also return thumbUrl, a ~330px preview of each image
